LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony has sworn itself to Solitude and the western holds. Svargrim's stewards will pay and feed those in his service.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take service with the High King in Solitude, who wants no part of the Alliance War.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Enlist_Requrements_No: Solitude has not heard enough good of you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Enlisted_To_Hostile_F: The west will not take an oath from its enemy.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Menu_Missions_Desc: Work posted by the High King's court. Payment comes from the harbor tolls once it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Provisions_Desc: Salted fish, bread and mead from the court kitchens.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Storage_Desc: Leave goods with the harbor master in any western hold.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Resign_Menu_Text: Break your oath to Solitude? The western jarls will hold it against you.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has gone back on its oath to Western Skyrim.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Resign_Button_Desc: Walk away from your service to the western holds.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Solitude no longer counts the colony among its sworn.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Work_0_Desc: Watch the docks at Solitude and keep the smugglers honest.
LanguageData.ESCP_WesternSkyrim_Work_1_Desc: Western housecarls fight the old way and expect you to keep up.
